name: mixture-of-models
description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest capable model. Simple and coding work runs in a headless child Claude Code on an Anthropic-compatible gateway (Palgu, OpenRouter, a LiteLLM proxy; GLM 5.3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, Mercury 3, ...); critical work stays in your main session on your subscription. Routes can name a family member (claude/sonnet on your Claude login, kimi/auto) or hand a turn to the Codex CLI. Ported from Maggy.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: Anthropic-compatible endpoint the child Claude Code sends routed turns to: https://api.palgu.ai/anthropic, https://openrouter.ai/api, or your LiteLLM proxy such as http://localhost:4000. Leave empty to stay observe-only.

gateway_key.title: Gateway API key
gateway_key.description: API key for that gateway: a Palgu key, an OpenRouter key, or a LiteLLM master or virtual key. Used only in the child process environment.

gateway_provider.title: Gateway provider
gateway_provider.description: auto (default: Palgu and OpenRouter are detected from the URL), palgu, openrouter, litellm (a LiteLLM proxy: bearer key, your proxy's model names) or anthropic-compatible.
